factors.name: Sun path (season and date)
factors.how: B's Sun vectors with A's Earth, DSN, terrain and 2 m panel, minus value_a

factors.name: Earth path (libration)
factors.how: B's Earth vectors and DSN times with A's Sun; delta = sunlit change, link_delta = link_pct change

factors.name: Terrain horizon
factors.how: value_b with the real LOLA horizon minus scenario B with a flat 0-deg horizon

factors.name: Panel height
factors.how: scenario B, 5 m vs 2 m panel, both raycast fresh with terrain.horizons()

blocking_ridge.tie_break: highest terrain horizon among bins with the most blocked steps

note: One-at-a-time attribution; bars need not add up exactly. Comms factor: swapping in B's Earth path (and DSN station times) changes link_pct by -0.4 points (A 50.0% -> B 49.6%); Earth's path cannot change sunlight (measured sunlit delta +0.0). Terrain and panel-height bars are measured on the slipped date B.
